{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check data types and missing values
dtypes = sales_df.dtypes
missing = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Display the first few rows to understand the structure
print('Data types:')
print(dtypes)
print('\nMissing values:')
print(missing)

# Check unique values in key columns
print('\nUnique values in campaign_start:')
print(sales_df['campaign_start'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in campaign_end:')
print(sales_df['campaign_end'].unique())

print('\nUnique values in converted:')
print(sales_df['converted'].unique())"}
